metadata.title: हम आदिवासी औरतों से माफ़ी माँगते हैं । We say sorry to Adivasi women
metadata.description:
The adivasis of India have a great culture and tradition. But there are few traditions, which must change now. One of these traditions is that women wash the feet of guests coming to their houses. In this episode, we talk about our experience when we visited tribal homes, and how we saw change in some communities, which is an indication of progress.

#santhal #adibasi
